kpis.description_fr: Coach = marque flagship Tapestry (~78 % CA). Repositioning premium réussi 2020-24. Marges expanding.
kpis.description_en: Coach = Tapestry flagship brand (~78% revenue). Successful 2020-24 premium repositioning. Margins expanding.

kpis.description_fr: Kate Spade = ~20 % CA Tapestry. Marque accessible luxury. Pressions Gen Z + competitive. Restructure underway.
kpis.description_en: Kate Spade = ~20% Tapestry revenue. Accessible luxury brand. Gen Z + competitive pressures. Restructure underway.

kpis.description_fr: Stuart Weitzman = chaussures premium. Plus petit segment. Difficultés persistantes, potentiellement cédé.
kpis.description_en: Stuart Weitzman = premium footwear. Smallest segment. Persistent difficulties, potentially divested.

kpis.description_fr: DTC ~80 % du CA (stores + e-commerce). Stratégie premiumization + control prix. Réduction wholesale department stores.
kpis.description_en: DTC ~80% of revenue (stores + e-commerce). Premiumization + price control strategy. Wholesale department stores reduction.

kpis.description_fr: 35 % du CA hors USA. Asie (Chine, Japon, Corée) prime driver. Coach Asia recovery post-COVID.
kpis.description_en: 35% of revenue outside USA. Asia (China, Japan, Korea) prime driver. Coach Asia post-COVID recovery.

notes: Tapestry fiscal year se termine fin juin (FY25 = juillet 2024-juin 2025). Acquisition Capri Holdings (Versace+Michael Kors+Jimmy Choo) abandonnée nov 2024 après FTC block.
